signature_matches.name: get file attributes
signature_matches.rule_src:
rule:
  meta:
    name: get file attributes
    namespace: host-interaction/file-system/meta
    authors:
      - michael.hunhoff@mandiant.com
      - anushka.virgaonkar@mandiant.com
    scopes:
      static: basic block
      dynamic: call
    mbc:
      - File System::Get File Attributes [C0049]
    examples:
      - 03B236B23B1EC37C663527C1F53AF3FE:0x180019824
      - B5F85C26D7AA5A1FB4AF5821B6B5AB9B:0x4028B6
      - B5F85C26D7AA5A1FB4AF5821B6B5AB9B:0x4029E0
  features:
    - or:
      - api: kernel32.GetFileAttributes
      - api: ZwQueryDirectoryFile
      - api: ZwQueryInformationFile
      - api: NtQueryDirectoryFile
      - api: NtQueryInformationFile
      - api: System.IO.File::GetAttributes
      - api: System.IO.File::GetCreationTime
      - api: System.IO.File::GetCreationTimeUtc
      - api: System.IO.File::GetLastAccessTime
      - api: System.IO.File::GetLastAccessTimeUtc
      - api: System.IO.File::GetLastWriteTime
      - api: System.IO.File::GetLastWriteTimeUtc
      - property/read: System.IO.FileSystemInfo::Attributes
      - api: stat
      - api: fstat
      - api: lstat
      - api: fstatat

signature_matches.name: read file on Linux
signature_matches.rule_src:
rule:
  meta:
    name: read file on Linux
    namespace: host-interaction/file-system/read
    authors:
      - joakim@intezer.com
    scopes:
      static: function
      dynamic: span of calls
    mbc:
      - File System::Read File [C0051]
    examples:
      - 7351f8a40c5450557b24622417fc478d:0x4059AD
  features:
    - and:
      - or:
        - os: linux
        - os: android
      - optional:
        - match: create or open file
      - or:
        - api: fgetc
        - api: fgets
        - api: getc
        - api: getchar
        - api: read
        - api: getline
        - api: getdelim
        - api: fgetwc
        - api: getwc
        - api: fscanf
        - api: vfscanf
        - api: fread

signature_matches.name: write file on Linux
signature_matches.rule_src:
rule:
  meta:
    name: write file on Linux
    namespace: host-interaction/file-system/write
    authors:
      - joakim@intezer.com

    scopes:

      - 7351f8a40c5450557b24622417fc478d:0x401E14

        - os: linux
        - os: android
      - or:
        - api: fputc
        - api: fputs
        - api: putc
        - api: write
        - api: fputwc
        - api: putwc
        - api: fputws
        - api: fwrite
        - api: putwchar
        - api: dprintf
        - api: vdprintf
        - api: fprintf
        - api: vfprintf
